use_case: occupation des sols et zones construites national

candidates.title: Etalab Cadastre 2024-10-01 - National GeoJSON bâtiments
candidates.rationale: A confirmed direct resource endpoint providing national-level building footprint data (bâtiments) for France in GeoJSON format, explicitly matching the use case of occupation des sols et zones construites. The directory listing shows multiple downloadable files with recent timestamps (2024-10-01 vintage), and the communes file is the primary national dataset.

candidates.title: Géoplateforme WFS GetCapabilities
candidates.rationale: A confirmed WFS service endpoint for BD TOPO V3 building footprints, directly serving France's national land use and built-up zones data through queryable GeoJSON features with complete attributes. This is an operational API endpoint, not a landing page.

candidates.title: Microsoft Building Footprints Dataset Links (2026-08-13)
candidates.rationale: A confirmed resource endpoint - a CSV index file providing direct download links to building footprint GeoJSON tiles for France organized by region and QuadKey. This is a real dataset with verified access, matching the use case (zones construites/built areas) and country scope, though the index itself requires interpretation to access actual data tiles.

candidates.title: Urban Atlas Land Cover/Land Use 2018 (vector), Europe, 3-yearly
candidates.rationale: A confirmed European-scale land cover/land use dataset with vector data for French urban areas at 1:10,000 resolution, including built-up zones. The resource endpoint is verified and the dataset explicitly covers France as part of its European scope, directly matching the use case for occupation des sols et zones construites, though it is a supranational product rather than France-specific.

candidates.title: Etalab Cadastre 2024-10-01 - GeoJSON per-département bâtiments
candidates.rationale: A directory index listing per-département GeoJSON files for building footprints from Etalab's cadastral dataset, covering all French departments. While this is a confirmed resource endpoint (directory of downloadable files), the page itself is a bare index with no descriptive content, making it impossible to verify metadata, coverage details, or data freshness from the page alone.

candidates.title: Microsoft GlobalMLBuildingFootprints
candidates.rationale: A confirmed resource endpoint providing ML-derived building footprints for France in GeoJSON/CSV format via Azure blob storage, accessible through a dataset index file. This is a global dataset with France coverage rather than an official French national land use dataset, and the ML-derived footprints are a proxy for built zones rather than authoritative occupation des sols classification.
